Creating tables and figures

Tables and figures should communicate the main empirical patterns clearly. They should have informative labels, consistent definitions, and enough information for the reader to understand what is being presented.

Generating outputs through code helps ensure consistency across revisions. It also makes it easier to update tables and figures when the underlying dataset or analysis changes.
